## Checklist
- [ ] Sidecar YAML added or updated
- [ ] Sources cited with licences, and actually read
- [ ] Safety level assigned honestly
- [ ] Difficulty level assigned
- [ ] Prerequisites, materials and limits filled in
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/build_index.py` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_i18n.py` passes, if translations changed
- [ ] Markdown lints clean, and lines are within 80 characters
- [ ] No medical, legal, financial or engineering advice
- [ ] The reference-material notice is present in new entries
